reason: I have one apartment next to my house and my guests ask the same three things: Wi-Fi, parking, where is the beach. I print a sheet in German and English and answer the rest on WhatsApp myself, I don't need to pay a company for that.
objection: With what I earn, €150 plus €35 every month is real money for one apartment, and the guests still end up writing to me on WhatsApp anyway when the machine doesn't know.
would_change_my_mind: If it was only for July and August for about €10 or €15 a month with no setup fee, and it really answered the Germans so I stop typing the same thing at 11 at night.
